executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $134.42 per resident day (42.2% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -0.1% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $587,074, 13.1% of the $4,497,110 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $880,504, $26.32 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $429,461 (48.8%), allocated fringe $96,074 (10.9%), non-wage costs $354,969 (40.3%). Raw food was $309,063 ($9.24 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $308,805, $9.23 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $215,240 (69.7%), allocated fringe $48,151 (15.6%), non-wage costs $45,414 (14.7%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $118,596, $3.54 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $87,266 (73.6%), allocated fringe $19,522 (16.5%), non-wage costs $11,808 (10.0%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2019, 2021, 2022 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

The filing is still listed in financials.json.

The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2021 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read). definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
